Please explain incident INC-7-0059. SKU AUT-CARR-1059 moves on lane MUN-LAX in automotive jit. The event label is carrier no show and the severity flag is medium. We expected 243 units and the floor counted 0. It has dwelled 7.8 hours at dock D30 during the afternoons shift. Temperature was not recorded. No 30-day on-time rate is available. Context: an engine-plant line that stops if this part is missing at the next shift change. The booked carrier did not collect during the tender window. The trailer is loaded and sealed but still at the shipper dock. The receiving site is waiting for a revised ETA. The carrier scorecard should record this missed collection. Backup capacity on this lane has not been tendered yet. No GPS ping exists because the freight never left. Return only the JSON explanation.
